other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 51 weeks/6 months imprisonment and/or a fine.

In relation to an offence committed before the provisions of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 are brought in force, the maximum sentence that the magistrates can impose is 6 months.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
